title: Empoli returns to the stage against Arezzo in clash of styles
seoTitle: Empoli vs Arezzo: Serie B Clash of Styles
subtitle: The match brings together two teams in search of decisive Serie B points
excerpt: Empoli and Arezzo face off in a thrilling clash. Empoli looks to maintain its positive home run, while Arezzo tries to turn the tide after.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Empoli and Arezzo face each other at the Stadio Carlo Castellani in a match that promises excitement. The Empoli team looks to maintain its positive home run, while Arezzo tries to turn the tide after two consecutive defeats. The match will be defined by the playing style of both sides and the tactical choices of coach Cristian Bucchi.

Empoli maintains home winning streak

Empoli won their last match, a game in which Carrarese were defeated 1-0 at the Stadio Dei Marmi. The Italian team had 59% possession and two shots, with the winning goal scored by Bogdan Popov in the 74th minute.

Arezzo seeks to reverse losing streak

Arezzo suffered two consecutive defeats in Serie B, including a 5-0 thrashing against Hellas Verona at the Stadio Marcantonio Bentegodi. The team had just 30% possession and a single shot on goal.

Tactics and confirmed lineups

Empoli confirmed their lineup in a 3-5-2 formation: Jacopo Seghetti (goalkeeper), Luca Magnino, Marco Curto, Cristian Cauz, Matteo Egan, Edoardo Biondini, Gerard Yepes, Edoardo Saporiti, Niccolo Corrado, Stiven Shpendi, and Joseph Ceesay.

Arezzo confirmed their lineup in a 4-3-3 formation: Alessandro Nunziante (goalkeeper), Alessandro Renzi, Matteo Gilli, Mauro Coppolaro, Samuele Righetti, Shaka Mawuli, Mattia Viviani, Artur Ionita, Alessandro Arena, Pietro Cianci, and Marco Olivieri.

Statistics that highlight the clash

  • Empoli has 4 wins, 4 losses, and 2 draws this season.
  • Empoli averages 1.1 goals per game, 3.8 shots, and 12.1 attempts.
  • Arezzo has 1 win and 2 losses, averaging 1.3 goals per game, 3.0 shots, and 11.7 attempts.
  • Empoli maintains 46.6% possession and 4.9 corners per game.
  • Arezzo has 37.7% possession and 3.7 corners per game.

Coach Bucchi's perspective

Coach Cristian Bucchi highlighted the need to maintain the team's identity and learn from recent matches. He emphasized that the clash against Empoli will be an opportunity to demonstrate their strength and avoid mistakes that could harm the team.

Conclusion of the matchup in perspective

Empoli, with a home winning streak, seems to be in an advantageous position. However, Arezzo looks to bounce back from two consecutive defeats and could surprise with their tactical strategy. The outcome will depend on the individual and collective performance of both teams at the Stadio Carlo Castellani.
